name: Dr. Christoph Baumeister
headline: Partner at Possible Ventures | CDTM | TUM | 3x Founder
summary:
If you want to connect with me and I don't know you personally yet, please add a short note on why. Thank you!

I am an early-stage deeptech investor with strong entrepreneurial roots, having transitioned to the investor side after co-founding three startups over eight years. Most recently, I co-founded Avi Medical, a hybrid health company, where I operated as Chief Product Officer and led Product and Marketing. Before that, I co-founded two hardware-focused startups: one in the IoT space and another focused on unattended deliveries. I also bring hands-on experience from innovation and strategy roles at major corporations, including Telefónica, Siemens, and BMW.

I hold a Master's Degree in Management and Electrical Engineering from TUM, an Honours Degree in Technology Management from CDTM, and a PhD in Consumer Behavior from TUM.
